title: Burst The Pipe
html:
so, as smart guys... we want to be successful.

so we need to see how success is actually bred.

which is where this module comes in...

this mindset comes down to a simple sentence.

success a j curve.

so obviously... we just need to study what a J curve actually is.

let's get into it

The Anatomy Of A J Curve.

so, this graph is something commonly used in things like private equity, investment, things of that nature.

now, as of writing this I don't have any investments, but this graph is the single thing that dictated my success.

and here's how...

I mean, listen...

why is success even hard?

really, why is it hard?

you probably think that you've not got the right business model, and other excuses like that.

let me tell you why it's hard.

it's hard because you have to work without seeing results.

listen...

the modern world is so connected with instant results.

you post a picture on instagram, you get instant likes...

or even things in nature...

you talk to someone, ask them a question, and you get an instant answer...

literally, everything in this world is "instant"

and I'm not saying this is bad or good in general.

but it is bad in terms of success.

why's that?

because you are programming your mind to think results will be instant.

and when results are not instant... your brain has no way of knowing if you are going the right way.

your brain tells you "is this even worth it?"

hopelessness, the worst emotion a man could feel.

and then... your brain justifies giving up because you see no results.

and the worst thing about this?

it will repeat with every single "business model" out there.

here, just take a look at the graph once again.

this is how success works.

you start...

and then your "returns" or "results" are literally underground.

you're missing social occasions, you're spending less time with family, you're working all day making your brain fatigued.

that would be fine... if there was results to show for it.

but here's the thing.

there is no results for your brain to "justify" the hard work you're putting in.

therefore, you are likely to quit.

and why are you likely to quit?

this all comes back to the laws of physics.

"every action has an equal and opposite reaction"

this is a quote by newton, and I mention it alot, you'll probably see it.

but here's the thing...

when you're putting so much work in, and there is no results to show... it breaks this quote.

or in other words, it breaks the laws of physics.

because this quote simply just means "the more you put in, the more you get out."

or "the less you put in, the less you get out"

basically saying your actions are equal and opposite to the results you're going to get.

the more you put in... the more you get out...

so, what happens when you're putting your ALL in, and nothing comes out?

for 1 week, then 2 weeks, then, 3 weeks, then a month...

you quit, naturally.

your brain is thinking logically, that "this isn't working, so I should just quit"

this was a very hard obstacle for me jump over... but I've finally did it.

and here's the mindset that got me through it.

so... listen up.

and install these new beliefs.

Why Do You Think Everyone Is An Overnight Success?

because they burst the pipe.

now... this is an analogy which helped me overcome my false beliefs about success.

let me explain this to you bro, it'll help you think differently.

so, hear this out... and keep this in mind....

Bursting The Pipe = A Piece Of Content Blowing Up, Landing A Client, Etc.

it can be whatever.

you know what... let me just give you an example.

How It Works.

now, hear this shit out...

this is what was in my notes before this business blew up for me :

"your favourite youtuber did not blow up by their videos looking like this:

1k views then 1.5k views then 2k views then 2.5k views and it carries on.

it does not go like that, it is more like:

1k views then 900 views then 1.1k views then 1k views.

then one day. ONE VIDEO BLOWS THE FUCK UP

1 million views, and wow

now he's an overnight success...

why? because he's getting so much more eyes on his course which then leads to more people buying it."

now... let's see myself as a prime example of this.

here... my tiktoks were getting 3-4k views on average...

and it keeps on happening, it's endless under 10k views.

it doesn't stop.. right? you get it.

it's just constant little views... and it's due to happen.

but here's what happens one day...

3.1 million.

and I gained 10K email subs from that one video.

so... if ONLY 1% of my email subs buy this network rn for $97...

that's 100 people.

100x100 = $10,000.

in other words, that video has enabled me to make my first 10K/Month... that's what it takes.

this was the video that burst the pipe.

before this video, I had uploaded 200 whole slideshows... (yes i counted it)

in other words... it took me 200 videos to burst the pipe.

on average I'd upload 1 huge slideshow a day... which means it took me about 200 days with little results.

WHAT DID I DO TO BURST THAT PIPE?

I applied pressure to it.

how?

by uploading videos and never stopping...

you keep on applying.

pressure, pressure, pressure.

WOW AND ITS BURSTS, now you never have to work again.

and that's exactly what will happen to you... if you KEEP applying pressure.

so, let's go through a little secret.

WHY DOESN'T EVERYONE BECOME THE OVERNIGHT SUCCESS?

what separates the kings from the peasants?

firstly, understand this.

success is a mindset, not a stack of money in your pocket.

what do broke people think when starting a business?

they will do their little tiktoks, maybe for a month... and then they'll quit because there is no results.

I mean, it's logical in a way... you don't see no results so you quit.

but listen... business is a different ball game, you do not think like a "normal person"

this is how a successful person would think.

they would start a business, and they will keep uploading, they will keep posting, keep cold calling...

for the first 1 month... or even 6 months, it's little results.

but the successful person still goes with the mindset of "bursting the pipe"

he strongly believes that the pipe will burst, so he will carry on.

and what is success?

success is just the game of never stopping, and this mindset makes it impossible to quit.

he will burst the pipe, it's inevitable.

imagine if you did 8 hours of work every single day for 2 YEARS STRAIGHT on ANY business.

you'd succeed, no questions about it.

got that?

good, you've now became 1 mindset closer to success.

WRITE THIS DOWN SOMEWHERE, DO IT ON PAPER AND STICK IT TO YOUR WALL.

I will keep on putting pressure, until the pipe bursts.

if you posted 1000 yt vids, tiktoks, tweets, one of them is due to blow up, and that's when the pipe bursts.

you're not looking for early results, you're looking to blow up later down the line.

that's all you look for, make the mindset change.

it's due to happen.

SUMMARY :

The rich do not look for early success, but keep applying pressure to the pipe and wait for it to burst.

success is always a J curve.

patience.
